image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The plates are greyish-green with visible growth lines and mottling. The anterior end is blunt, and the surrounding environment includes dark algae or organic matter and wet rock surfaces.
